PLATFORM_FEATURES.name: Mobile app for iPhone and Android
PLATFORM_FEATURES.description: Your whole LensTrybe business in your pocket. Take bookings, reply to clients, send invoices and check payments from your phone. In build now.

PLATFORM_FEATURES.name: More creative disciplines
PLATFORM_FEATURES.description: LensTrybe opens with Photographers and Videographers. Drone Pilots, Video Editors, Photo Editors, Social Media Managers, Hair and Makeup Artists and UGC Creators follow after launch.

PLATFORM_FEATURES.name: Two-way calendar sync
PLATFORM_FEATURES.description: Connect Google Calendar or Apple Calendar so your LensTrybe availability and your own diary stay in step in both directions. Stop double booking yourself.

PLATFORM_FEATURES.name: Creative community feed
PLATFORM_FEATURES.description: A place for creatives on LensTrybe to share work, ask questions and find people to collaborate with. Groups, mentions and collaboration posts are being built now.

photographer.name: Shot list builder
photographer.description: Build a shot list on any job as a checklist, tick frames off as you get them, and keep prep lists and gear lists on the same project. Available in your project workspace today.

photographer.name: Location scouting notes
photographer.description: Save GPS pins, lighting windows, parking and access instructions for every location, then reuse them on future shoots at the same spot.

photographer.name: Style questionnaire templates
photographer.description: Send a branded pre shoot questionnaire to capture mood, styling and image references. Answers save against the booking so you arrive prepared.

photographer.name: Pass selects to a Photo Editor
photographer.description: Send your approved selects straight to a Photo Editor on LensTrybe with your notes attached. Arrives once Photo Editors join the platform.

photographer.name: Culling tool
photographer.description: Review a full shoot in one workspace and mark each frame Keep, Maybe or Reject. Doing this properly in a browser is a serious piece of work, so we are looking at it rather than promising it.

photographer.name: Deposit and balance payment splits
photographer.description: Take a deposit at booking and the balance later, with LensTrybe chasing the second payment. Anything touching payments has to be right first time, so this one is under review.

photographer.name: Weather and light window
photographer.description: Sunrise, sunset, golden hour and the forecast for the date and place you are shooting, on the booking itself. Stop working it out by hand the night before.

photographer.name: Travel and mileage
photographer.description: Log the kilometres for a shoot and have them land in Expenses at the ATO rate, ready for your Tax Hub at the end of the financial year.

photographer.name: Watermarks and download controls
photographer.description: Watermark a proofing gallery, cap how many times a set can be downloaded, and lift both once the client has paid. Proofing and favourites already work, this finishes them.

photographer.name: Mini sessions
photographer.description: Publish a day of fixed price, fixed length slots and let clients book and pay themselves. Christmas minis and headshot days without a single back and forth email.

photographer.name: Packages catalogue
photographer.description: Set a package up once, with its inclusions and price, then pull it into a quote, an invoice and your public profile. Stop rebuilding the same wedding package every time.

photographer.name: Book a second shooter
photographer.description: Need a second shooter for a wedding? Post the day, book another LensTrybe creative, and agree the split up front. The other photographers are already here, so it is a search rather than a group chat.

photographer.name: Model and property releases
photographer.description: Send a release to a subject or a venue and have it signed on the day, stored against the shoot. Commercial and stock work needs it, and chasing a signature afterwards never goes well.

videographer.name: Project timeline tracker
videographer.description: Move every job through stages you name yourself across pre production, production and post. See your whole slate and spot a schedule risk early. In your Projects board today.

videographer.name: Shot list builder
videographer.description: Build scene by scene shot lists as checklists on the project, with whatever detail the job needs. Available in your project workspace today.

videographer.name: Production brief and run sheet
videographer.description: One shareable brief with call times, locations, contacts and logistics, published as a run sheet so the whole crew works from the same page on shoot day.

videographer.name: Revision round tracker
videographer.description: Track each revision cycle with timestamps and change notes, so clients can see what was updated and agreed revision limits hold without an argument.

videographer.name: Music licensing log
videographer.description: Record every track used on a project with licence type, source and expiry. A clear compliance record before anything is delivered.

videographer.name: Weather and light window
videographer.description: Sunrise, sunset, golden hour and the forecast for your shoot date and location, on the booking itself, so you can plan the day around the light before you leave the house.

videographer.name: Travel and mileage
videographer.description: Log the kilometres for a shoot and have them land in Expenses at the ATO rate, ready for your Tax Hub at the end of the financial year.

videographer.name: Watermarks and download controls
videographer.description: Watermark a review cut, cap how many times a delivery can be downloaded, and lift both once the client has paid.

videographer.name: Packages catalogue
videographer.description: Set a package up once, with its inclusions and price, then pull it into a quote, an invoice and your public profile. Stop rebuilding the same production package every time.

videographer.name: Book crew for a shoot day
videographer.description: Need a second operator, a sound recordist or someone on lights? Post the day, book another LensTrybe creative, and agree the split up front.

videographer.name: Model and property releases
videographer.description: Send a release to talent or a venue and have it signed on the day, stored against the shoot. Commercial work needs it, and chasing a signature afterwards never goes well.

drone_pilot.name: Gear and battery register
drone_pilot.description: Log every aircraft, controller and battery with serial numbers and values, track what the kit is worth for insurance, and check gear out to a job. In your Inventory today.

drone_pilot.name: Flight log
drone_pilot.description: Capture date, site, weather, altitude, aircraft and duration for every mission, and keep a complete operating history you can export.

drone_pilot.name: Pre flight checklist
drone_pilot.description: Run your own safety checklist against each booking so no step is missed, and keep the completed record attached to the job.

drone_pilot.name: Battery cycle tracker
drone_pilot.description: Count charge cycles per battery and watch pack health over time, with a nudge when one is due for replacement.

drone_pilot.name: Insurance and registration reminders
drone_pilot.description: Store policy and registration expiry dates and get reminded before they lapse, so you stay job ready without the last minute scramble.

drone_pilot.name: No-fly zone notes
drone_pilot.description: Flag airspace restrictions during planning. Getting this wrong has real consequences for a pilot, so we will only build it if we can do it accurately. Always check CASA yourself.

video_editor.name: Edit status board
video_editor.description: Move jobs through stages you name yourself, rough cut to colour grade to sound mix to delivered, and see your workload and bottlenecks at a glance. In your Projects board today.

video_editor.name: Handover checklist
video_editor.description: Keep a final checklist on the project for exports, project files, fonts and proxies, so nothing is missed at signoff. In your project workspace today.

video_editor.name: Revision round tracker
video_editor.description: Log every revision round and what changed in each pass, keeping scope clear and reducing arguments about extra edits.

video_editor.name: Receive rough cut handoff from a Videographer
video_editor.description: Accept rough cuts from Videographers on LensTrybe with source links and notes attached, so you can start editing without chasing files.

video_editor.name: Timestamp feedback
video_editor.description: Clients leaving comments on exact timecodes in your cut. This needs proper video playback built into the platform, so it is an idea rather than a commitment.

photo_editor.name: Batch job tracker
photo_editor.description: Track every editing job through stages you name yourself, with deadlines and values, so you can prioritise by volume and due date. In your Projects board today.

photo_editor.name: Receive culled selects from a Photographer
photo_editor.description: Get curated selects in one handoff with client instructions and references attached, so you start with the context you need.

photo_editor.name: Client approval workflow
photo_editor.description: Send an edited set for approval with a clear approve or request changes flow, and only deliver once signoff is in.

photo_editor.name: Turnaround time estimator
photo_editor.description: Work out a delivery date from image volume and your usual edit speed, so you set an expectation you can actually meet.

photo_editor.name: Style reference board
photo_editor.description: Attach mood boards and visual references to a job so your look stays aligned with client direction the whole way through.

photo_editor.name: Retouching notes per image
photo_editor.description: Leave precise instructions on individual images instead of one note for the whole job, which cuts repeat revisions.

social_media_manager.name: Content calendar
social_media_manager.description: Plan posts by client, platform and campaign in a board or month view, move them through Idea, Draft, Scheduled and Posted, and store captions and hashtags on each one. Assign posts to your team on Expert and Elite.

social_media_manager.name: Content ideas board
social_media_manager.description: Park every idea as it comes to you with notes and platforms, then promote the good ones straight into the calendar. In your dashboard today.

social_media_manager.name: Caption library
social_media_manager.description: Save your best captions as reusable templates across clients and campaigns. Captions already save on each post, this makes them a library you can pull from.

social_media_manager.name: Content approval workflow
social_media_manager.description: Send drafts to the client for sign off before anything publishes, and track approvals and requested edits in one place.

social_media_manager.name: Monthly reporting card
social_media_manager.description: Generate a clean monthly summary with the metrics and highlights that matter, ready to send without building a report by hand.

social_media_manager.name: Receive finished gallery from a Photographer
social_media_manager.description: Accept delivered galleries from Photographers on LensTrybe and go straight to producing content, with no download and upload loop.

social_media_manager.name: Platform performance dashboard
social_media_manager.description: Follower growth, reach and engagement by client and platform in one view. This depends on approval from Meta and TikTok, which is not ours to promise, so it stays an idea for now.

hair_makeup_artist.name: Client records
hair_makeup_artist.description: Keep a record for every client with notes, contact details and booking history, so you walk into a repeat appointment knowing exactly what you did last time. In your CRM today.

hair_makeup_artist.name: Look book builder
hair_makeup_artist.description: Build a visual mood board for each booking and share it before the day, so the look is agreed early and nothing changes at the last minute.

hair_makeup_artist.name: Skin and allergy profile
hair_makeup_artist.description: Save skin type, sensitivities and product preferences against a client and carry them into every future appointment. Safer service, less asking twice.

hair_makeup_artist.name: Product kit log
hair_makeup_artist.description: Record every product used on a look, down to shade and finish, so you can recreate it exactly for a follow up booking.

hair_makeup_artist.name: Trial and day-of booking flow
hair_makeup_artist.description: Handle the trial and the event day as linked but separate appointments, keeping notes, timings and outcomes for both.

hair_makeup_artist.name: Artist call time sheet
hair_makeup_artist.description: Coordinate several artists with clear call times and roles, so a big wedding or production runs to schedule.

ugc_creator.name: Brand deal tracker
ugc_creator.description: Track every deal through stages you name yourself, with the brand in your CRM, deliverable dates and deal value in one place. In your Projects board today.

ugc_creator.name: Rate card builder
ugc_creator.description: Build a shareable rate card link with packages, inclusions and pricing, so you answer a brand enquiry in one message.

ugc_creator.name: Usage rights log
ugc_creator.description: Record the agreed usage window, platforms and licensing for each deal, and check your rights before you repost or repurpose anything.

ugc_creator.name: Content brief builder
ugc_creator.description: Capture objectives, hooks, format requirements and calls to action in a structured brief, so scope is clear before you shoot.

ugc_creator.name: Posting schedule tracker
ugc_creator.description: See which deliverables are live, scheduled or still pending across every active deal, and stay on top of your commitments.
